notes:
I found two venues with their own pages that a family could walk into. I couldn't confirm either one for December 27 to 30 specifically. Neither page states a toddler age range, so I left age out rather than guess.

- **Zoo Ecomuseum:** 
Their visitor page says they're open every day, with last admission at 4 PM.
 
It lists 9 AM - 5 PM for every day of the week, and December 25 as closed.
 The zoo is in Sainte-Anne-de-Bellevue, on the island of Montréal. It is about a 25-minute drive from downtown, according to a tourism site (not the zoo's own page).
- **Montréal Science Centre:** 
Their visitor page lists Monday through Friday 9 a.m. – 4 p.m. and Saturday and Sunday 10 a.m. – 5 p.m.
 The centre's older holiday-hours post, from a past year, gave different hours for late December. That tells me holiday hours can differ from the regular ones, so check before going.

**Not included:** I couldn't read the Biodôme's own page. Only third-party listings came up, so I left it out.
